Kerala faces ₹41,000 crore revenue arrears; commission proposed

The Comptroller and Auditor General reported that Kerala's revenue arrears reached over ₹41,000 crore in the fiscal year ending March 2025. In response to these financial challenges, Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced plans to form a commission to investigate backwardness among specific regions.
